title: TEN MEN, A LATE EQUALISER AND A TEAM SHEET MYSTERY AT PALACE
description:
Palace went a man down, and still left with a point.

Adam Wharton, the England midfielder, was central to Palace's night until the 77th minute. Then came a second yellow after a clash with Wouter Burger, and Palace played the rest with ten men.

Alexander Prass had put Hoffenheim ahead in the 7th minute. Daichi Kamada equalised in stoppage time. 1-1.

Then there's the team sheet. Axel Disasi had played every Europa League minute, and Pierre Sage left him out. Sage called it an internal decision. That's all we've got.

Point earned or point rescued? Tell us below which one you'd call it.
